title: My Flashcards
text:
This is my flashcard. It has a word on the front. It has a picture on the back.

I read the word and say it. Then I turn the card to check the picture. I study every day.

questions.text: What is on the front of the flashcard?
What does the reader do after saying the word?
options: Turns the card to check the picture

questions.text: Why does the reader look at the picture?
options: To check the meaning of the word

questions.text: What kind of person is the reader most likely to be?
options: A person who is learning new words
A person who is a doctor
A person who is a pilot

vocabulary.definition: a small card with a word or picture used for learning
to look at something to make sure it is correct

paragraph_translations: Це моя картка для запам'ятовування. На передньому боці є слово. На звороті є картинка.
Я читаю слово і вимовляю його. Потім я перевертаю картку, щоб перевірити картинку. Я вчуся щодня.
